responsibility: This file is the main matcher for Fortran declaration and attribute statements. It parses type declarations, attributes, DATA statements, procedure and derived-type declarations, BIND(C), ENUM/STRUCTURE/UNION forms, GCC-specific directives and pragmas, and associated declarator state, creating symbols, data lists, and parse-tree nodes that describe declared entities before semantic resolution; it also owns front-end state for declaration-time attributes, DATA list construction, and several GNU/DEC extensions.
